pick.name: Pydantic AI
pick.what: Typed Python agent framework: validated outputs, DI, MCP, durable execution (Temporal, DBOS, Prefect...), pydantic-evals, OTel/Logfire
pick.why: Same type-first ethos as the TS side, model-agnostic, validates structured output natively, small API Claude Code writes well

alts.name: LangGraph (Python)
alts.what: Low-level graph orchestration with durable execution and human-in-the-loop
alts.why: Best for resumable long-running stateful workflows

alts.name: Claude Agent SDK (Python)
alts.what: Claude Code loop as Python library
alts.why: Pick if the backend is Claude-only and benefits from built-in tools; billed to Max credits

candidates.name: Pydantic AI
candidates.verdict: Pick: typed, light, model-agnostic, built-in evals

candidates.name: CrewAI 1.15.32
candidates.verdict: MIT; anonymous telemetry on by default; commercial AMP upsell

candidates.name: LlamaIndex 0.14.25
candidates.verdict: Best for RAG pipelines, less for general agents

decision: Pydantic AI stays the Python pick: typed end to end, provider-neutral, ships evals/MCP/durable execution. Use Python only where work is data/ML-heavy; otherwise stay in TS. Switch to LangGraph for long-running resumable workflows.

verify.note: Version/licence/limits match registry or official page.
